mentor.name: owls

piece.t: Many owls hunt at night.
They have big eyes that help them see in the dark.
They can also fly very quietly.
Owls grab mice with their talons.
Talons are the sharp, curved claws on an owl's feet.
That is how owls find and catch food at night.

sort: Owls have soft feathers.
An owl can turn its head far around.
Owls have big eyes on the front of their face.
Owls eat mice and other small animals.
Some owls catch fish.
An owl can swallow a mouse whole.
mentor.op: Owls are the most beautiful birds.
mentor.hook: Have you ever seen an owl?

mentor.name: whales

piece.t: Whales are huge animals that live in the ocean.
They breathe air, so they swim up to the top of the water.
A whale breathes through a blowhole.
A blowhole is a nose hole on top of a whale's head.
Some whales also sing long songs.
Now you know more about these big ocean animals.

sort: Whales have flippers.
Whales have a thick layer of fat under their skin.
A whale moves its tail up and down to swim.
Some whales eat tiny animals called krill.
Some whales hunt fish and squid.
A blue whale can eat a lot of krill in one day.
mentor.op: Whales are the best animals in the sea.
mentor.hook: Have you ever seen a whale?
ex: Some whales eat tiny animals called krill.

mentor.name: robins

piece.t: You can see robins in many yards and parks.
A robin has a gray back and an orange chest.
Robins also pull worms out of the ground.
They build nests out of grass, twigs, and mud.
A nest is a home a bird makes for its eggs.
Now you know how to spot a robin.

sort: Robins eat earthworms.
Robins eat berries in the fall and winter.
A robin tilts its head to look for worms.
Robins often build nests in trees.
A robin's eggs are light blue.
Mother robins sit on the eggs to keep them warm.
mentor.hook: Have you ever seen a robin?

mentor.name: carrots

piece.t: Carrots are vegetables that grow under the ground.
We eat the root of the carrot plant.
A root is the part of a plant that grows down into the soil.
Carrots also have green, leafy tops.
Most carrots are orange, but some are purple, white, or yellow.
Now you know about carrots and where they grow.

sort: A carrot grows from a tiny seed.
Carrots need sun and water to grow.
A carrot takes a few months to grow.
People eat carrots raw or cooked.
Carrots can be cut into sticks for a snack.
Carrots can be cooked in soup.
mentor.hook: Have you ever eaten a carrot?
ex: A carrot grows from a tiny seed.

mentor.name: chickens

piece.t: Chickens are birds that live on many farms.
Hens lay eggs in a nest.
A hen is a female chicken.
Chickens also scratch the dirt with their feet to find seeds and bugs.
They cannot fly very far.
Now you know some facts about these farm birds.

sort: Many chickens have a red comb on their head.
Chickens have feathers and two wings.
Chickens have scaly feet.
Chickens eat seeds and grain.
Chickens eat bugs and worms.
Farmers often feed chickens corn.
mentor.op: Chickens are the funniest farm animals.
mentor.hook: Have you ever seen a chicken?

mentor.name: the wind

piece.t: The wind can be gentle or very strong.
You cannot see the wind, but you can feel it.
It also makes leaves rustle and flags flap.
A breeze is a soft, gentle wind.
A strong wind can knock down trees.
Now you know what the wind can do.

sort: Wind moves clouds across the sky.
Wind can carry seeds far away.
Wind blows sand into hills called dunes.
Sailboats use wind to move.
People fly kites on windy days.
Wind turbines use wind to make power.
mentor.op: Windy days are the most fun.
mentor.hook: Have you ever felt the wind?
ex: Wind can carry seeds far away.

mentor.name: school bus drivers

piece.t: School bus drivers help children get to school.
They drive big yellow buses.
A bus driver stops at each bus stop.
A bus stop is a place where people wait to get on a bus.
Drivers also check that everyone is sitting down before they go.
Now you know how bus drivers help children get to school safely.

sort: A school bus has a stop sign on its side.
A school bus has flashing red lights.
A school bus has many seats.
Bus drivers pick up children in the morning.
Bus drivers take children home after school.
Bus drivers watch the road carefully.
mentor.op: Riding the bus is the best part of the day.
mentor.hook: Have you ever seen a school bus?
ex: A school bus has flashing red lights.

mentor.name: seals

piece.t: Seals spend time in the water and on land.
They have flippers for swimming.
A thick layer of blubber keeps them warm.
Blubber is the fat under a seal's skin.
Many seals also eat fish.
That is how seals live in the sea and on the shore.

sort: Seals have whiskers.
Seals have short fur.
Seals have strong flippers.
A baby seal is called a pup.
Seal pups drink milk from their mothers.
A mother seal can find her pup by its smell.
mentor.op: Seals are the cutest animals in the sea.
mentor.hook: Have you ever seen a seal?

off.t: A piano has black and white keys.

ends.name: ducks
piece: Ducks are birds that spend a lot of time in the water.
They have webbed feet that help them swim.
Oil on their feathers keeps them dry.
Ducks eat plants, seeds, and small water bugs.
ends.close: Ducks have bodies that are made for life on the water.
ends.fact: Ducks can sleep with one eye open.
ends.l1: Ducks can sleep with one eye open to watch for danger.
ends.now: Now you know that ducks can sleep with one eye open.

ends.name: raccoons
piece: Raccoons are animals with a black mask of fur around their eyes.
They have bushy tails with rings.
Raccoons use their front paws like hands.
Many raccoons look for food at night.
ends.close: Now you know a lot about these masked animals.
ends.l1: Now you know that raccoons can climb tall trees.
ends.now: Now you know that raccoons can climb trees.

ends.name: tigers
piece: Tigers are the biggest cats in the world.
Most tigers have orange fur with black stripes.
Tigers are good swimmers, and they like to cool off in water.
They hunt deer and wild pigs.
ends.close: These striped cats are the biggest of them all.
ends.fact: A tiger's roar can be heard far away.
ends.l1: A tiger's loud roar can be heard from very far away.
ends.now: Now you know that a tiger's roar can be heard far away.

ends.name: clouds
piece: Clouds float high in the sky.
They are made of tiny drops of water or bits of ice.
Some clouds are white and puffy.
Dark gray clouds can bring rain.
ends.close: Next time you look up, you will know what clouds are.
ends.fact: Some thin clouds look like feathers.
ends.l1: Some very thin clouds look like long, white bird feathers.
ends.now: Now you know that some thin clouds look like feathers.

ends.name: sea stars
piece: Sea stars are ocean animals shaped like stars.
Most sea stars have five arms.
A sea star can grow a new arm if it loses one.
They have tiny tube feet under each arm.
ends.close: These star-shaped animals are at home in the sea.
ends.fact: Sea stars eat clams and mussels.
ends.l1: Sea stars eat clams and mussels by pulling their shells open.
ends.now: Now you know that sea stars eat clams and mussels.

ends.name: farmers
piece: Farmers grow plants and raise animals.
Many farmers plant seeds in the spring when the ground warms up.
They water their crops and pull weeds.
Some farmers raise cows, pigs, or chickens.
ends.close: Farmers take care of plants and animals.
ends.fact: Some farms have a big red barn.
ends.l1: Some farms have a big red barn for the animals.
ends.now: Now you know that some farms have a big red barn.

ends.name: pine trees
piece: Pine trees stay green all year.
They have long, thin needles instead of flat leaves.
Pine trees grow cones that hold their seeds.
Many birds build nests in pine trees.
ends.close: Pine trees are green in every season.
ends.fact: Some pine trees live for thousands of years.
ends.l1: Some pine trees live for thousands of years.
ends.now: Now you know that some pine trees live for thousands of years.

ends.name: horses
piece: Horses are big animals that can run fast.
They have long legs and hard hooves.
Horses eat grass and hay.
A horse can even sleep while it is standing up.
ends.close: Now you know about these big, fast animals.
ends.fact: A horse's long tail helps it swat away flies.
ends.l1: Now you know that a horse's long tail helps it swat away flies.
ends.now: Now you know that a horse's long tail helps it swat away flies.

Painting is more fun than drawing.
Music class is the best class.
